text_block_list.text:
“—From today on, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with Winning Ticket begins!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The day I saw the Nippon Derby for the first time—

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: "The Derby is a race packed with dreams."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"A girl watching the race next to me
told me that!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For real, the excitement was incredible!!
Everyone was watching the race with sparkling eyes, their hearts racing with thrilling anticipation!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What I remember most
—is what happened after the Umamusume crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
They did it, they did it! They finally did it!!
The dream came true!! Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The cheering was incredible!
It felt like the air itself was shaking!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was shouting excitedly, full of joy—
and the lady next to me was even crying a little."

text_block_list.name: Young Ticket
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?! Does your tummy hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
No...
...I'm just so happy that she won.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That was the moment I realized.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I want to move people just like this! I want to do something that lets them dream!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why someday...
I want to run in the Japanese Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Thad's whad I thoughd when I enrolled, bud... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Uwaaaaaaah!
Just rhinking aboud id makes me wanno cwy~~~!!

On the first day of practice, Winning Ticket finished her training
full of fighting spirit—

While cooling down together with her friends,
she reminisced about old memories.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, shut up.
I've heard that story a hundred times already.
(Narita Taishin—she's Winning Ticket's cool and dry classmate.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: At this rate, we'll be able to recite it from memory soon too.

(Biwa Hayahide—a logic-loving
classmate of Winning Ticket.)

Whether she heard her friends' chilling remarks or not...
Winning Ticket wiped away her tears and continued.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And today, even someone like me is finally taking on the Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer and closer to the Derby Umamusume
I've dreamed of being for so long~~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Thank you for choosing me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're the one who reverse-scouted me, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be a crazy journey full of ups, downs, and Derbys from here on, but still!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is the Derby on the table...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you!!!!!
"—And with that, Winning Ticket grabbed my hand and pumped it up and down vigorously."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for the Derby together!!!!!

Her burning passion for the Derby is genuine.
That dedication was what made me want to become her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Same here, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiiiiight!
Let's do thiiiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Told ya not to scream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's overlook it just for today.
They've really been looking forward to this, after all.

Behind the shouting Winning Ticket stood the two of them,
gently watching over her despite all their grumbling.
After finishing training, I visited a newly opened taiyaki shop together with the girls.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"We've explored quite a bit.
That takoyaki stand over there, the crepe shop, the steamed buns..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eating together makes it three times as delicious~~~!
Seeing Winning Ticket looking genuinely thrilled brings a natural smile to my face. This seems to be an everyday occurrence for her.
choice_data_list: You two sure get along well.
You two sure get along well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! That's right!
We've been rivals ever since we enrolled!
Shortly after enrollment, during a time trial—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight, 2400 meters!
I'll definitely run it all the way to the end~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible. Freshmen usually
start around 1,000 meters, you know.
There's no way I could do that yet...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Right? And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: "Three of them?" you say.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: That's Tracen Academy for you...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then,
on your marks... Start!”
At the signal, the three of them sprinted forward all at once!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Up ahead is Biwa Hayahide.
And those footsteps behind me... Narita Taishin, right?!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I'll pass Biwa Hayahide on the final stretch!
My stamina's totally shot—but still!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(That should be the same for everyone! I'll show them
what my late surge can do... Hehe!)

Before long—they reached the final stretch,
the very place Winning Ticket had been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff, pant*...!!
Is this... the place...!?

As if anticipating the moment Winning Ticket shifted gears,
Biwa Hayahide picked up her pace as well.

The back I was supposed to pass
never seemed to get any closer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit...!!
—Beside the flustered Winning Ticket, another smaller shadow... Narita Taishin dives in!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

A brilliant late charge that Winning Ticket couldn't muster.
Closing in with a sharp burst of final speed, she pulled level with Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (I don't want to lose! Even though I don't want to lose—!)
Leaving Winning Ticket behind, the two crossed the finish line locked in fierce competition...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Amazing, you're amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide!
Even though it was our first time running together, it's like she knew the exact moment I'd kick into gear!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That's wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, Narita Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible late charge! Even though I was
confident in my own finishing kick, I stood no chance!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh!! This gets me so fired up!!
To think I have such amazing classmates~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm Winning Ticket!!
I'm aiming for the Derby!
Guess that makes us rivals from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What a weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Weird!? Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
He-haha...! 
Thank you, Winning Ticket.
I'm honored to have earned your respect.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I, too, found myself drawn to your emotional drive.
Your intensity during the race was second to none.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "C-Can't be serious...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Once again... I am Biwa Hayahide.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ehehe! Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—And then, I'm not really sure how,
but before I knew it, I'd become friends with Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Taishin acknowledged the enthusiasm
you showed in the mock races and school races.
Were you not aware of it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You were!?
You should've told me, Taishiiiiin~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up, be quiet, idiot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Are you mad or something!?

On a street corner in the shopping district at dusk,
their lively chatter showed no signs
of stopping anytime soon.
And so, the journey to turn Winning Ticket into a 'Derby Umamusume' began!
